nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field, $n$ a natural number and $a, b$ integers such that the image of $b$ in $K$ is nonzero. Then the image in $K$ of the homogenized cyclotomic value $\Phi_n(a, b)$ equals $b^{\varphi(n)} \Phi_n(a/b)$, where $\Phi_n$ is the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial over $K$, $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function, and $b$ and $a/b$ are computed in $K$.
nodes.title: Homogenized cyclotomic value in a field

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and every integer $a$, the homogenized cyclotomic value $\Phi_n(a, 1)$ equals $\Phi_n(a)$, the value at $a$ of the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial with integer coefficients.
nodes.title: Homogenized cyclotomic value with second argument one

nodes.summary: For all integers $a$ and $b$, the homogenized cyclotomic value $\Phi_1(a, b)$ equals $a - b$.
nodes.title: Homogenized cyclotomic value of index one

nodes.summary: For all integers $a$ and $b$, the homogenized cyclotomic value $\Phi_2(a, b)$ equals $a + b$.
nodes.title: Homogenized cyclotomic value of index two

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and integers $a, b$, let $c_0, \dots, c_{\varphi(n)}$ be the integer coefficients of the $n$-th cyclotomic polynomial, whose degree is $\varphi(n)$, where $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function. The homogenized cyclotomic value is the integer
nodes.title: Homogenized cyclotomic value

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
